verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own cap-table page documents that users can configure vesting schedules for founders and employees, and ESOP management appears in the freemium tier. However, the pack never describes cliffs, milestone-based vesting, acceleration on exit, or automatic tracking of vested versus unvested amounts. Missing for 10: documented cliff support, milestone or performance vesting, single- or double-trigger acceleration on exit, automatic vested/unvested tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: configure vesting schedules for founders and employees
